funding.supported_assets_note: Two modes. 'Credit Mode': the card borrows USDC against collateral deposited in Kamino protocol vaults on Solana (cbBTC, wETH, SOL, JitoSOL, USDC, USDT, xStocks) — 'borrowing is executed by the Kamino protocol - XPlace is not the lender'; credit opens 'automatically at the point of tap'; users can 'repay, add collateral, or reduce your borrow at any time'. 'Cash Mode' spends a stablecoin balance directly. Deposits 'Always non-custodial'.

credit_terms.liquidation_risk: Borrow interest is charged by the Kamino protocol; no APR is published on the pages read (Platinum only promises 'lower borrow rates'). Vault LTVs shown on the homepage Earn section: Tether 80%, Ethereum 70%, Solana 65%, Bitcoin 65%, Jito Staked Solana 65%; 'Kamino's lending logic enforces LTV ratios' and users 'get notifications well before liquidation thresholds'; the Earn disclaimer warns of 'liquidation risk'. Cashback is earned on borrowed money, so interest can exceed the reward.

eligibility.usage_note: No country or eligibility list is published on the pages read: 'services are not available in all jurisdictions'; '160+ countries' refers to Visa acceptance, not to cardholder eligibility. The site links separate 'Card Terms — US' and 'Card Terms — International User' documents on docs.x.place, which could not be fetched in this run (URLs not surfaced by search). Every country is therefore 'to confirm'; the product is not US-only.

editorial.summary: Crypto-backed Visa credit card on Solana: collateral sits in Kamino vaults and each purchase borrows USDC (Credit Mode), or a stablecoin balance is spent directly (Cash Mode). Issued by Third National under a Signify Holdings (Rain) programme; operator Pontech Group L.L.C-FZ, Dubai. Four annual tiers (Free to $999/y) with 0.5–2% USDC cashback in Credit Mode and FX from 1% down to 0%. The borrow interest rate, ATM terms, card prices and the eligible countries are not published on the pages read.
good_for: Solana/Kamino users who already hold cbBTC, SOL, ETH or stablecoins and want to spend against them without selling
Frequent travellers considering Platinum (0% FX, lounges) who can justify $999/year
not_for: Anyone who wants to know the borrowing cost before applying — no APR is published
Residents of the EEA until the International Card Terms confirm eligibility (no country list)
Users needing ATM cash or a known physical-card price
watch_outs: Cashback is earned on borrowed USDC that accrues Kamino interest at an unpublished rate; liquidation risk if collateral falls (LTV 65–80%).
Operator is a Dubai free-zone technology company ('not a bank, licensed lender or investment firm'); EEA/UK regulatory status not stated.
Silver monthly limit shown as $20,000 on the homepage and $10,000 on the membership page.
Physical cards: only Silver live; Gold and Platinum 'coming soon'.
Card Terms (US / International) not read — eligibility, KYC and fee details may differ from marketing pages.
Site name metadata contains Cyrillic look-alike characters ('XPlaсе'); verify the domain x.place when linking.
